description: Compare an uploaded bundle with another one: files added, changed and removed, unpacked size before and after, the bytes a device downloads, and warnings about content that should not ship (.env files, .git, node_modules, source maps, large new files). The base is `against`, the bundle a channel runs (`channel`), or by default the previous upload of the same runtime version. Encrypted bundles cannot be inspected.

against.description: Bundle to compare with; omit to use channel or the previous upload

appId.description: OtaKit app ID. Optional on a local connection whose project configures one; required otherwise.

channel.description: Compare with the stable bundle this channel runs for the bundle's runtime version; null for the base channel

name: diff_bundles
title: Compare two OtaKit bundles
